tests.name: ready_consumer_join_survives_cancelled_recording_waiter_and_counts_once
tests.construction: OriginalConsumerJobs actual reserve/retain path owns a real spawn_blocking JoinHandle. The task owns a real UnixStream endpoint, waits on a controlled channel, and returns the original Refused error.
tests.cut: Three actual receive_original_consumer futures are polled while the task is blocked. A clone of their same original Shared is awaited to Ready, and real FD EOF is checked. The private job recording lock is then held while all three callers are polled to Pending at their second lock attempt. One waiter is dropped in that state.

tests.name: ready_session_worker_join_survives_cancelled_recording_waiter
tests.construction: Uses the existing same-UID/synthetic-proof phase_connection to create the real phase Session, external custody and worker. Actual Session Drop drives retirement and actual worker abort. No session_retired write is added by the test.
tests.cut: On the current-thread runtime, three real stop_and_join_retired_session_tasks futures are synchronously polled before the scheduled worker abort can complete. The same retained Shared is then awaited to its actual Cancelled result. The private worker record lock is held while all three callers reach their second lock and one waiter is dropped.

The registry changes only through product code to handle=None and observed=Some(actual Cancelled); repeated cleanup retains the same result. The actual fixture peer thread is joined.
tests.no_synthetic_completion: No fabricated custody, worker outcome, C/RootIntent token, business actor or physical Root-exit claim. This observes fault retirement only.
